summary: Read renamed PTY advertisements and existing Fabric adapter state without changing exposures

replay.detail: No replay, state rewrite or backfill.

schema.detail: Gateway settings, route handshakes and adapter state retain their existing formats.

rules.detail: Terminal capability checks, owner and node selection, and runtime incarnation handshakes remain unchanged. The adapter still grants no PTY access.

compatibility.detail: CLI and TUI direct terminal readers select an exact st3/pty/<fleet> or fractal/pty/<fleet> advertisement from the current selected owner and node. Without such an advertisement they retain st3/pty/<fleet>. Gateway settings already accept both client service names; a fixture now locks in that behavior. Adapter default state discovery reads an existing ~/.local/state/st-fabric-adapter or ~/.local/state/fractal-fabric-adapter home and refuses two populated homes rather than merging authority. Explicit --state-dir bypasses discovery. Fresh installs retain the legacy default; no producer or exposure changes.

downtime.detail: No host actions or migration are required.

manual.detail: Only conflicting populated adapter homes require choosing the authoritative directory explicitly with --state-dir.

recovery.detail: No stored paths or services are rewritten. Older binaries still require their existing spellings. Retain accepting readers until the rename ledger's admitted-site inventory proves old advertisements and state homes absent.
